description: This is a PHP unit test abstract class, EndpointTestCase, used for testing API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system. It provides utility methods for creating requests, mocking API classes, and asserting exceptions related to API request validations.
external_methods: GrayHAT	estcase	esting_kernel	ests	ests	ests.extension	ests.ExtensionsKernelTestCase::__construct

classes.name: EndpointTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for testing API endpoints, providing common setup and utility methods for creating requests, mocking API classes, and asserting expected exceptions.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates a new Request object with supplied query, request data, and attributes.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMockBuilder
methods.description: Returns a PHPUnit MockBuilder for the specified API class, initialized with a constructed Request based on provided request parameters.

methods.name: expectNotImplementedException
methods.description: Sets expectation that the test should throw a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: expectRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Sets expectation that the test should throw a RecordNotFoundException.

methods.name: expectBadRequestException
methods.description: Sets expectation that the test should throw a BadRequestException.

methods.name: expectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Sets expectation that the test should throw an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: expectForbiddenException
methods.description: Sets expectation that the test should throw a ForbiddenException.

methods.name: assertInvalidParamException
methods.description: Executes a validation closure and asserts that it throws an InvalidParamException with specified invalid parameters.
